program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((seed (first (find-color g 2)))
         (region (connected-region g (first seed) (second seed) (lambda (r c v) (or (= v 0) (= v 2))))))
    (foldl (lambda (p out)
             (if (= (at g (first p) (second p)) 0)
                 (set-cell out (first p) (second p) 8)
                 out))
           g region)))
